Subject: Summary: Peter Sloan reference for Xavier Lim (call notes)

Team — notes from my 8/25 09:30 call with Peter (30m). I’ll paste into the hiring packet doc after we collect Aisha’s.

Call details:
- Duration: 30 minutes (Tue 8/25 09:30 PDT)
- Role while working with Xavier: Peter was his manager (Ex-Emplabs, 2019–2023)

Key takeaways (bulleted):
- Technical ownership: Xavier led the migration of the online model-serving stack to a more batched inference path. Peter cited concrete metrics: 35% reduction in 99th percentile tail latency after the migration (team-level).
- Problem-solving: handled a production incident that required quick rollbacks and a targeted KV cache fix; Peter highlighted composure under pressure and clear runbook improvements Xavier authored.
- Teamwork & communication: strong at cross-functional syncs, approachable with engineers and product partners; occasionally prioritized delivery timelines over longer-term refactors — Peter framed this as context-aware tradeoffs, not negligence.
- Areas to probe: deeper on long-term maintainability choices, testing strategy for the batched inference pipeline, and examples of mentoring more junior engineers.

Attachment: I uploaded the call summary to the candidate folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1x-lim-references (will add Peter’s calendar invite there).

Next steps: Dev — can you confirm Aisha’s slot? Once we have her notes I’ll add both summaries to the hiring packet and send to the hiring committee.

Thanks,
Marissa
